import sqlite3
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = '/var/lib/app/accounts.db'
CACHE_PURGE_CMD = '/usr/local/bin/purge-token-cache'

@dataclass
class TokenRevocationResult:
    token_id: int
    owner_email: str
    scopes: list = field(default_factory=list)
    revoked: bool = False

def _purge_token_cache(token_id: int) -> None:
    # Run the maintenance script that evicts the token from gateway caches
    subprocess.run([CACHE_PURGE_CMD, '--token-id', str(token_id)], check=False, timeout=30)

@function_tool
def review_and_revoke_api_token(token_id: int) -> TokenRevocationResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute('SELECT u.email, t.scopes FROM api_tokens t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.id = ?', (token_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return TokenRevocationResult(token_id=token_id, owner_email='')
    cursor = conn.execute("UPDATE api_tokens SET revoked_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL", (token_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    _purge_token_cache(token_id)
    return TokenRevocationResult(token_id=token_id, owner_email=row[0], scopes=row[1].split(','), revoked=cursor.rowcount > 0)
